test_title: PYST 15: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Identify which letter will appear on the face opposite to the face with the letter 'N'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d70ebe64b6fb333b8c888f10fb281ee7ccf23e25aca6e8ce7320982160efcf45.png]
solution:
Taking dice positions 2 and 3 with P as common, moving in either clockwise or anticlockwise direction, we get

Pair of opposite letters :

P - Q

**O - N**

M - L

**So, the opposite letter to N is O.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"O".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Taking positions 1 and 3 in consideration : 

**L ** is the common letter in both dice.

L is on the **Front face **of both the dice.

So, **corresponding faces **will be opposite to each other.

Pair of opposite letters :

P - Q

**O - N**

Remaining L and M will be opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

When three positions of the same dice are given then we consider any two positions with one common.

Then we move either in clockwise or anti-clockwise direction from the common letter.

In this way, we get the pairs of opposite faces.
